streak_assessment: This audit follows exp-0094, which tested the previous audit's chosen direction — scoring the first in-search-tree repetition as a draw via a _root_ply guard plus board.is_repetition(2) past the root — and returned an inconclusive paired arena (19-30-15, score 0.531, CI [0.459, 0.602]) with CI, reliability stress (worst move 0.80 s vs the 2.25 s ceiling, init 0.22 s), resource and policy gates all clean and zero agent failures; not promoted. That makes five consecutive scientific non-improvements since the exp-0089 promotion (exp-0090 king-danger 0.508, exp-0091 passed pawns 0.531, exp-0092 rook files 0.492, exp-0093 pawn structure 0.484, exp-0094 in-tree repetition 0.531), meeting the numeric half of the handoff stop rule. Two whole mechanism families are now saturated in their tested form: (a) search/move-ordering/quiescence/time-management (history/killer/TT-best-move ordering, aspiration windows, guarded null-move, bounded check extensions/evasions, forcing-check priority, mate-distance scoring, quiet promotions and delta pruning in quiescence, timeout unwinding, quiescence stalemate repair, TT halfmove bucketing, ordering-key micro-optimisation, time-budget tuning), and (b) middlegame positional leaf scalars (four orthogonal flat hand-weighted features all landed in arena noise 0.48–0.53). Draw contempt (exp-0063) and repetition-probe performance/timing (exp-0068/exp-0082/exp-0094) are also spent. However, the numeric threshold is necessary but not sufficient: the stop rule also requires that no materially different, well-motivated, self-contained experiment remains anywhere. One does. No experiment in the 48-record window has added a tablebase-free endgame "mop-up" king-drive term — the standard technique for converting won lone-king endgames — and that mechanism attacks the single largest reservoir of lost points in the current evidence (roughly 28–30 of 64 games drawn by non-forced threefold repetition, a large share of them in endgames where the candidate holds decisive or winning material but shuffles because neither the piece-square model, the accepted mobility term, nor mate-distance scoring supplies a progress gradient once a forced mate is beyond the search horizon). It is distinct in kind from every exhausted mechanism, keeps the trained model determinative everywhere except near-dead-won endgames, and is a closed-form code change with tiny fixed coefficients. So this is not yet true scientific saturation. It is, though, the last self-contained hand-weighted evaluation idea: if exp-0095 is inconclusive that is the sixth consecutive non-improvement and the next audit should declare scientific_saturation and escalate an offline positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json to the human.
recurring_failure_modes: Non-forced threefold-repetition draws dominate the score: 30/64 games in exp-0094 ended by threefold repetition, many from equal-or-better positions and several from materially winning endgames, with aimless piece shuffling once no forced mate is within the search horizon. This failure mode has been unchanged across exp-0089 through exp-0094.

Mirror-pair closed-position draws: entire opening pairs (reti, caro-kann, pirc, dutch, nimzo-indian, slav) draw by repetition with both colours in exp-0094, indicating the engine has no plan or progress gradient in locked pawn structures and simplified positions.

Favourable-endgame conversion failure: positions where the candidate is up material (including, in earlier batches, a clean piece) are repeatedly halved; the flat piece-square model plus the 3 cp/square mobility term give no cornering or progress signal in KR/KQ-vs-K-type endings, and mate-distance scoring only helps once a mate is actually found in-tree.

Every decisive loss is a checkmate (15 of 15 losses excluding one adjudication), strongly skewed toward the candidate playing White, via long enemy king hunts after premature simplification or pawn/king advances that expose the candidate king. exp-0090's quadratic king-danger term did not resolve this and king safety is now effectively saturated as a self-contained scalar.

next_direction.title: Tablebase-free endgame mop-up king-drive term for converting won lone-king endgames
next_direction.hypothesis: In agent.py's _model_evaluate, after the existing piece loop, when the position is a clearly winning lone-king endgame, add a bounded coordinate-based mop-up term that gives alpha-beta a monotone gradient toward cornering the bare king and marching our own king up, converting a meaningful share of the ~30 non-forced threefold-repetition draws (many of them materially winning endgames) into wins without retraining. Concretely: (1) At module load, build a 64-entry tuple CENTER_DISTANCE giving each square's Chebyshev-or-Manhattan distance to the central 4x4 (standard mop-up 'center manhattan distance' table: values 6,5,4,3,3,4,5,6 by file added to the same by rank, range 0..6). (2) During the existing `for colour, sign` / `for piece_type` loop, cheaply accumulate, per side, the count of non-king pieces and a boolean 'has_mating_material' (>=1 queen or >=1 rook, or >=2 minor pieces, and 0 pawns on the weak side). (3) After the loop, gate: exactly one side (the 'strong' side) has mating material and the other side (the 'weak' side) has zero non-king pieces AND zero pawns (lone king only). If the gate is false, return unchanged. (4) If the gate is true, compute drive = 4.7 * CENTER_DISTANCE[weak_king_square] + 1.6 * (14 - chebyshev_or_manhattan_distance(strong_king_square, weak_king_square)), hard-cap drive at 60, and add `+drive` to score if the strong side is board.turn else `-drive`. Use only board.king(colour), chess.square_file/square_rank, and the piece counts already gathered. No change to _ordered_moves, _quiescence, _negamax, the transposition table, _forced_draw, _budget_seconds, the iterative-deepening loop, MATE handling, or weights/.
next_direction.rationale: The dominant retained failure across six straight experiments is non-forced repetition draws, and the evidence shows a large, specific sub-population: endgames where the candidate has decisive or winning material but shuffles to a threefold draw because nothing in the evaluation rewards making progress once a forced mate is beyond the horizon (depth ~6-8 plus a 3-ply capture quiescence often cannot see mate in a KRvK-type ending). The accepted mobility term (exp-0089) rewards attacked squares, but a lone king already has near-zero mobility and driving it to the edge barely changes our attacked-square differential, so mobility supplies no cornering gradient. Mate-distance scoring (exp-0048/exp-0065/exp-0081, exhausted) only acts once a mate is found in-tree. Draw contempt (exp-0063, exhausted) changes the value assigned to a recognised draw but gives no directional signal toward the win. The mop-up evaluation is the textbook tablebase-free method for precisely this problem and has never appeared in the 48-experiment window, so it is materially new. It keeps the trained model fully determinative of every non-lone-king position (i.e. essentially all real play and all model-ablation openings); the term only perturbs positions the model was barely trained on and where the objectively correct move is close to tablebase play rather than model-subjective. It is self-contained: a ~15-line code change, one precomputed tuple, four fixed scalars, no coefficients from training, no weights change, no pipeline.
next_direction.guardrails: Scope: edit only agent.py; weights/ untouched; no change to _ordered_moves, _quiescence, _negamax, the TT key or size, _forced_draw, _budget_seconds, or the iterative-deepening loop. NPS/leaf cost: the gate must piggyback on the existing _model_evaluate piece loop (accumulate the per-side non-king piece count and mating-material flag while it already iterates board.pieces); when the gate is false — virtually every middlegame and normal-endgame node, and every node in the model-ablation openings — the added cost is a handful of integer comparisons, so target node cost within 1.02x and confirm the arena reaches comparable search depth. When the gate is true the extra cost is ~2 board.king calls, 2 table lookups and a distance computation, which is negligible and rare. Model-move-ablation safety: the 3 s ablation openings start from standard opening positions and effectively never reach a bare-king endgame, so the term is inert on that path; require model_move_ablation to still show minimum_move_differences >= 8 and the strength gate >= 0.625 and confirm both are materially unchanged, not merely passing. Reliability/flag risk: no new work on the hot path, so re-verify the full stress_time_left_ms grid (1 / 25 / 100 / 1000 / 120000) with required_failures 0 and init under 50 s; exp-0094's worst single move was 0.80 s against the 2.25 s ceiling and 0.0004 s against 0.75 s at the 1 ms clock, and this change adds no measurable work, so that margin must be preserved. Correctness bounds: hard-cap the drive contribution (<= 60 model units, far below a minor piece and below any real mate score) so it can only break ties among equal-material king-shuffle positions and can never flip the sign of a position that material evaluation already calls winning or losing; never apply the term when the weak side still has a pawn (KPvK / KRPvKR can be fortress draws and the cornering logic is wrong there) or when material is equal; use only the documented python-chess API (board.king, board.pieces, chess.square_file, chess.square_rank) and never read library internals. If the paired arena is inconclusive, do NOT re-tune this by adjusting the 4.7 / 1.6 / 60 constants, widening the gate to include pawns or lone-minor endings, adding a second endgame lookup, or switching the distance metric and calling it a new experiment — that outcome is the sixth consecutive non-improvement, and the next audit should declare stop_condition scientific_saturation and hand the human an offline retrain of weights/model.json with trained positional features (pawn structure, king shelter, passed pawns, king activity) since every self-contained hand-weighted option will then be exhausted.

audit_summary: Champion is agent.py at commit 4a0c988 (recorded as exp-0089): PVS/LMR negamax with exchange-aware capture ordering and losing-capture pruning in quiescence, a depth-keyed transposition table keyed on (transposition_key, halfmove_clock, depth), partial root-iteration salvage, and a fast draw/terminal path (_forced_draw = halfmove_clock>=100 OR is_repetition(3) OR insufficient material), over a tapered learned piece-square model, plus the accepted fixed 3 cp/square net-mobility leaf term and a flat castling-rights scalar. The batch just completed produced exp-0094, the previous audit's chosen direction: scoring the first in-search-tree recurrence of a position as a draw via a module-global _root_ply guard plus board.is_repetition(2) past the root in _forced_draw. It returned an inconclusive sequential paired arena (19 wins, 30 draws, 15 losses, score 0.531, CI [0.459, 0.602]) with CI, reliability stress (init 0.22 s, worst move 0.80 s vs the 2.25 s ceiling), resource (peak 120 MB vs 2 GB), ruff, smoke and policy gates all clean and zero agent failures; not promoted, so in-tree repetition draw detection is not in the champion. This is the fifth consecutive scientific non-improvement since exp-0089 (exp-0090 king-danger 0.508, exp-0091 passed pawns 0.531, exp-0092 rook files 0.492, exp-0093 pawn structure 0.484, exp-0094 0.531), meeting the numeric half of the stop rule. exp-0094's retained games show the failure modes unchanged: 30/64 draws by threefold repetition, many from equal-or-better positions and a large share from materially winning endgames with aimless shuffling; entire opening pairs (reti, caro-kann, pirc, dutch, nimzo-indian, slav) drawn by repetition with both colours; and all 15 losses are checkmates (plus one adjudication) skewed toward the candidate as White via long king hunts after passive simplification. The search/ordering/quiescence/time family and the middlegame positional-scalar family are both saturated, and repetition semantics (value via exp-0063 contempt, timing via exp-0068/exp-0082/exp-0094) are spent. Decision: CONTINUE, stop_condition null, because one materially different, well-motivated, self-contained experiment remains that no record in the 48-experiment window has tried and that targets the largest point reservoir at its cause: a tablebase-free endgame mop-up king-drive term (precomputed center-distance table plus a king-proximity term, gated strictly to won lone-king endgames and hard-capped well below a minor piece), the textbook method for converting the won endgames the engine currently shuffles into threefold draws. It is distinct from mate-distance scoring (acts only once a mate is found in-tree), from mobility (a lone king has no mobility to suppress), and from draw contempt (no directional signal), keeps the trained model determinative of every non-lone-king position and every model-ablation opening, adds negligible node cost behind a gate that piggybacks on the existing piece loop, and touches no protected surface, no weights, no time management and no TT structure. This is the last self-contained evaluation idea: if exp-0095 is inconclusive the next audit should declare scientific_saturation and escalate an offline positional-feature retrain of weights/model.json to the human. Uploading remains out of scope; the live competition upload is v3 tied to the exp-0089 champion (checksum prefix 55fec84c6dab, state.json status active) and this audit does not touch it.
